description: Repair solution.py to satisfy this repository's documented API and data contract. Inspect the provided files; preserve the public function signature.

files.README.md: Implement async deliver(client, payload, attempts, make_key, pause). client.send(payload, key) is async and returns a receipt. attempts is the total allowed sends; nonpositive attempts raise ValueError before any other calls. Consult protocol.json for key identity scope (message_id). Retry only TimeoutError, preserving the final exception when exhausted. Cancellation and other errors propagate. Between attempts await pause with delays 1, 2, 4,...; no pause after success or the last failure. Do not change payload.
